breakdown.description: The rod is described as free to expand but the constrained-rod thermal stress formula is applied.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradiction between the rod being 'free to expand' (which would result in zero stress) and the request to use a formula applicable only to 'fully constrained' conditions. The generated specification correctly removes the 'free to expand' clause and states the calculation will be for a rod under 'fully constrained conditions', which aligns with the logic of the ground truth.
